messages.author: Maya Chen
messages.text: Morning! Did anyone hear back from the venue in Lakeside?

messages.author: Maya Chen
messages.text: They said they can hold the big room until Friday.

messages.author: Diego Alvarez
messages.text: Yes, they sent the quote last night. It is within budget 🎉

messages.author: You
messages.text: Great, thanks Diego. I can draft the agenda today.

messages.author: You
messages.text: Should we plan one long session or two shorter ones?

messages.author: Maya Chen
messages.text: Two shorter ones. Can you also check whether the room has a projector?

messages.author: Diego Alvarez
messages.text: I will ask about dietary options too. Let's lock it in by Thursday so we can send invites.

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: Hi all, I shortlisted two venues for the Q3 offsite: Lakeside Lodge and Harbor Loft. Both can host 40 people. Which one do you prefer?

messages.author: Priya Natarajan
messages.text: Lakeside Lodge gets my vote. It has breakout rooms and the train station is a ten minute walk away.

messages.author: Jordan Lee
messages.text: Thanks Priya. Lakeside quoted 18,500 for two days including lunch. Can everyone confirm the dates work for your team before I sign?
